whatis.h2: What is a wholesale to retail markup?
whatis.intro: A wholesale to retail markup is what a store adds to your wholesale price to set its shelf price. It is stated as a share of the store's cost. For a distributor it is the second of two steps: your markup sets the case price, then the store's markup sets the shelf.

cards.title: Two markups that multiply
cards.body: Your markup and the store's stack on top of each other. They multiply rather than add: your 30% and the store's 66.8% take a $22.00 case to 2.17 times its cost on the shelf.
cards.alt: Light bulb, for two markups stacking on one case

cards.title: What the store's share pays for
cards.body: The $1.59 a unit the store keeps is gross margin. Shelf labor, rent, spoilage and promotions all come out of it before any of it is profit.
cards.alt: Storefront, for the costs a store's margin has to cover

cards.title: Which accounts it fits
cards.body: The chain fits accounts that resell your case one unit at a time, such as grocers, markets and convenience stores. A restaurant turns a case into plates and prices on food cost instead.
cards.alt: Map pin, for the accounts that resell a case unit by unit

look.h2: Three places the shelf price math slips
look.intro: The math in both steps is fixed. Real accounts break it at the inputs, most often in one of these three places.

steps.title: Units the store actually prices
steps.body: Count the units the store puts a price on, not the items packed inside. If the items come in twin packs, the store prices half as many units at twice the cost.

steps.title: The case price after deals
steps.body: If the case carries an off-invoice deal, the store's real cost sits below your list case price. Enter what the buyer actually pays, or the shelf comes out too high.

steps.title: The price ending the store uses
steps.body: The calculator sets the shelf on the target margin, to the cent. Stores round to their own price endings, so ask how this one rounds before you defend a case price.

vos.h2: Where VOS fits next to the markup chain
vos.h3: Reps sell the shelf instead of taking the order
vos.body: VOS does not calculate markups or shelf prices. It takes the routine order off your reps. Stores order by voice in the VOS app, from their own guide at your case prices.
